title: Budget: sum overflow
prompt:
**Tình huống.** n ≤ 100000, a[i] up to 10^9. Compute the total sum of the array. What is mandatory?

**Thuật toán nào phù hợp nhất? Chương trình chỉ cần in ra chữ cái.**

**A)** int suffices

**B)** unsigned int suffices

**C)** long long — the sum reaches 10^14, int overflows

**D)** Big integer library

tests.name: answer
tests.hint: 10^5 × 10^9 = 10^14 > 2^31−1 ≈ 2.1·10^9. int/unsigned wrap around silently; long long is mandatory.
